construction: Independently authored deterministic illustrative counts. No employer data, client-derived parameters, identifiers, model outputs, or historical performance were used to construct these values.

outcomes.clicks: Synthetic click count; CTR denominator is impressions.
outcomes.completed_views: Synthetic completed-play count; distinct from TrueView view definitions and sales conversions.
outcomes.qualified_leads: Fictional business outcome used to exercise objective-aware decisions; not an actual tracked or attributed conversion.

ground_truth.baseline: Equal cohort mix for both creatives. A has higher CTR in each cohort.
ground_truth.mix_shift: Conditional response rates unchanged from baseline. A receives mostly cold-cohort impressions; B mostly warm-cohort impressions. Raw CTR ranking reverses because of delivery mix.
ground_truth.within_cohort_decline: Same delivery mix as mix_shift. A's conditional click and lead rates halve and completed-view rates decline; B remains unchanged. This decline is authored, not inferred from real data.

limitations: Not a validated market simulator, randomised experiment, or evidence of real advertising lift.
Fixed-mix standardisation is descriptive; causal conclusions require an appropriate identification design.
Do not pool this fixture with participant or Google Ads evidence, train a production policy on it, or upload its outcomes as real conversions.
A recommendation depends on the selected objective; CTR ranking is not qualified-lead or profit ranking.
